rows.what: Added Route::ClusterMap (bounded, duplicate-refusing wire type), a grant-scoped broker/service arm backed by observed lease holders and advertised addresses (QIP_EVENT_FABRIC_ADVERTISE), and qip-transport ClusterClient/LeaderFollowingTransport that fetch the map before producing and follow one leader change. Proven through two real qip-fabricd instances: leader killed, same client acked at epoch 2.
rows.remains: No composition root builds a ClusterClient from a SrvResolver and fabric_srv_owner; the SRV lookup is only exercised in qip-transport tests, and no deployed binary uses LeaderFollowingTransport. Producer breaker is keyed per partition, not per authority. Module still not instantiated in Terraform.

cluster.rs refresh-after-failure dropped: 'the client never followed the leader change'
protocol.rs duplicate check disabled: 'called Result::unwrap_err() on an Ok value'
protocol.rs bound > to >=: 'the bound itself is allowed'
